title: Scientifiq
text: Unlocking Insights: Scientifiq is where cutting-edge AI meets the world of scientific research, patents, and innovation. This web app transforms vast amounts of data into actionable insights, helping researchers and organizations navigate the ever-expanding universe of knowledge.

Built with Node.js and Svelte, Scientifiq is powered by BigQuery, Elasticsearch, and MongoDB to deliver lightning-fast and precise search results. Using advanced data analysis and AI, it predicts commercial, scientific, and social scores for papers, researchers, and patents, and evaluates the potential impact of paper abstracts and descriptions.

A key part of the project involved training and refining multiple AI models using Python, PyTorch, and Google Cloud Vertex AI. I worked closely on data preparation, model training, evaluation, and validation, ensuring the robustness and reliability of the predictions. This included verifying model outputs and statistical results that support the published research paper “Measuring the Commercial Potential of Science.”

The app keeps its data continuously up to date through automated weekly extraction pipelines and scales reliably on Google Cloud and AWS. By combining rigorous scientific validation with production grade engineering, Scientifiq delivers smarter insights and faster decisions bringing the future of research and innovation into the present.
